```{r setup}
project_root <- rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
setwd(project_root)

pacman::p_load(Seurat, monocle3, tidyverse, patchwork, RColorBrewer, pheatmap)
```


# Load object
```{r}
# The processed cells from a1_preprocessing.Rmd, with their counts, metadata, UMAP and clusters
a1_clean <- readRDS(file = "A1_single_cell_data/objects/a1_clean.rds")

cds <- new_cell_data_set(GetAssayData(a1_clean, layer = "counts"),
                         cell_metadata = a1_clean@meta.data,
                         gene_metadata = data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(a1_clean), row.names = rownames(a1_clean)))

# Cluster colours as in the ShinyCell plots
cluster_colours <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(nlevels(a1_clean))
names(cluster_colours) <- levels(a1_clean)
```


# Seurat Embedding and Clusters
```{r}
# The trajectory is learned on the UMAP of Fig. 1A, with the Seurat clusters. Monocle3 only adds the principal graph and the genes along it
reducedDims(cds)[["UMAP"]] <- Embeddings(a1_clean, "umap")

cds@clusters[["UMAP"]] <- list(clusters = setNames(a1_clean$cluster_name, colnames(a1_clean)),
                               partitions = factor(setNames(rep(1, ncol(cds)), colnames(cds)))) # One partition, the cells form one continuum
```


# Trajectory
```{r}
# One principal graph through all cells
cds <- learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)

# There is no biological start point, so I manually set the order start at the end of the graph that holds the most TE-high cells, to fit the UMAP on Fig1
graph <- principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]]
graph_ends <- names(which(igraph::degree(graph) == 1))

closest_vertex <- cds@principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pr_graph_cell_proj_closest_vertex[colnames(cds), 1] # Graph node of each cell
cell_nodes <- igraph::V(graph)$name[closest_vertex]

te_high_per_end <- table(factor(cell_nodes[cds$cluster_name == "TE-high"], levels = graph_ends))
start <- names(which.max(te_high_per_end))

cds <- order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes = start)


# UMAP coloured by the order, the left half of Supplementary Fig. 1B
pseudotime_umap <- plot_cells(cds,
                              color_cells_by = "pseudotime",
                              label_cell_groups = FALSE,
                              label_leaves = FALSE,
                              label_branch_points = FALSE,
                              label_roots = FALSE,
                              cell_size = 0.5,
                              trajectory_graph_segment_size = 0.4) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(8, "mm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(2.5, "mm"))
```


# Genes along the Trajectory
```{r}
# Genes detected in at least 10% of the cells, as in FindAllMarkers
expressed <- rowMeans(counts(cds) > 0) >= 0.1

# Trajectory test (Moran´s I)
trajectory_test <- graph_test(cds[expressed, ], neighbor_graph = "principal_graph", cores = 1) %>%
  relocate(gene_short_name) %>%
  arrange(desc(morans_I))

write.csv(trajectory_test, "A1_single_cell_data/results/A1 Trajectory Genes.csv", row.names = FALSE) # All tested genes, Supplementary Table 1
```


# Supplementary Figure 1B
```{r}
# Supp. Fig. 1B: UMAP coloured by the order (left) and the genes along it (right)
# The 30 trajectory genes (q < 0.05) with the highest Moran's I, genes with a symbol only, otherwise unreadable
top_genes <- trajectory_test %>%
  filter(q_value < 0.05, !grepl("^g\\.", gene_short_name), gene_short_name != "Pif5") %>%
  slice_head(n = 30) %>%
  pull(gene_short_name)

# The cells in 100 equal bins along the order, each gene scaled across the bins and sorted by where it peaks
cell_order <- order(pseudotime(cds))
bins <- cut(seq_along(cell_order), 100, labels = FALSE)

expression <- normalized_counts(cds, norm_method = "log")[top_genes, cell_order]
binned <- sapply(split(seq_along(bins), bins), function(i) Matrix::rowMeans(expression[, i]))
binned <- t(scale(t(binned)))
binned <- binned[order(apply(binned, 1, which.max)), ]

# The bar on top: the most common Seurat cluster of each bin
bin_cluster <- sapply(split(as.character(cds$cluster_name[cell_order]), bins), function(x) names(which.max(table(x))))
bin_annotation <- data.frame(Cluster = factor(bin_cluster, levels = levels(a1_clean)), row.names = colnames(binned))

trajectory_heatmap <- pheatmap(pmin(pmax(binned, -2.5), 2.5), # Values beyond -2.5 and 2.5 in the end colours, as the heatmap in Supplementary Fig. 1A
                               cluster_rows = FALSE,
                               cluster_cols = FALSE,
                               show_colnames = FALSE,
                               annotation_col = bin_annotation,
                               annotation_colors = list(Cluster = cluster_colours),
                               color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(7, "RdYlBu")))(100), # Blue-yellow-red, the pheatmap default of the bulk heatmaps
                               breaks = seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 101),
                               legend_breaks = c(-2, 0, 2, 2.5),
                               legend_labels = c("-2", "0", "2", "Scaled expression"), # The last label is the legend title
                               border_color = NA,
                               fontsize = 7.2,
                               fontsize_row = 6.5, # Gene names 6.5 pt, as in panel A
                               silent = TRUE)

fig_trajectory <- (pseudotime_umap | wrap_elements(full = trajectory_heatmap$gtable)) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.9)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm"))

fig_trajectory

ggsave(filename = "A1_single_cell_data/plots/SuppFig1B Monocle3 Trajectory_v2.png", plot = fig_trajectory, width = 200, height = 80, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
